-- Let's understand how to compute each loss component in watts
-- degradation loss = powratew * (cumdegpct / 100)
-- soiling loss = powratew * (soillosspct / 100)  
-- inverter loss = powratew * ((100 - inverteffpct) / 100)
-- TSL = degradation_loss + soiling_loss + inverter_loss

SELECT p.panemark, p.powratew, pr.measpoww, 
       (pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric as cumdegpct,
       e.soillosspct,
       (i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric as inverteffpct,
       -- degradation loss in watts
       p.powratew * ((pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100) as deg_loss_w,
       -- soiling loss in watts
       p.powratew * (e.soillosspct / 100.0) as soil_loss_w,
       -- inverter loss in watts
       p.powratew * ((100 - (i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric) / 100.0) as inv_loss_w,
       -- total system loss
       p.powratew * ((pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100) 
       + p.powratew * (e.soillosspct / 100.0)
       + p.powratew * ((100 - (i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric) / 100.0) as tsl_w
FROM panel p
JOIN performance pr ON pr.solmodref = p.panemark
JOIN inverter i ON i.siteref = p.hubregistry
JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = p.hubregistry
LIMIT 5;

-- Check if powlossw matches degradation loss (deg_loss_w)
SELECT p.panemark, pr.powlossw, 
       p.powratew * ((pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100) as deg_loss_w
FROM panel p
JOIN performance pr ON pr.solmodref = p.panemark
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.panemark AS panel_id,
    p.powratew AS power_rating_w,
    pr.measpoww AS current_power_w,
    (pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric AS degradation_pct,
    e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
    (i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
    -- Inverter loss in watts (using IEL)
    ROUND(p.powratew * ((100 - (i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric) / 100.0), 2) AS inverter_loss_w,
    -- TSL = degradation loss + soiling loss + inverter loss (all in watts)
    ROUND(
        p.powratew * ((pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric / 100.0)
        + p.powratew * (e.soillosspct / 100.0)
        + p.powratew * ((100 - (i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct')::numeric) / 100.0),
    2) AS total_system_loss_w
FROM panel p
JOIN performance pr ON pr.solmodref = p.panemark
JOIN inverter i ON i.siteref = p.hubregistry
JOIN environment e ON e.arearegistry = p.hubregistry
LIMIT 5;
